description: Navigation destination shown as an actionable card.

howToUse: Use it for a destination that needs a line of context: a project, a settings area, the next page of a guide.
With `href` it is a link; without it, a button that runs `onClick`.
Mark the page people are on with `current`. Use `variant="dashed"` for "Create new…" at the end of a list.
Put an `Avatar` or icon in `leading`, and a count or role in `meta`.
alternatives: An action that changes data: Button.
Content with image to read, not a destination: ContentCard.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the card. A disabled card is skipped.
Opens the destination. Without `href`, `Space` also works.

props.name: meta
props.description: Meta on the right, before the chevron (e.g. role pill, counter).

props.name: leading
props.description: Optional leading slot: `Avatar` or icon via ReactNode.

props.name: href
props.description: With `href` it renders `<a>`; without `href` it renders `<button>`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the card (no click, no Tab focus on the link).

props.name: current
props.description: Marks as the current destination (primary border + background, `aria-current`).

props.name: variant
props.description: `dashed` variant = create action ("create new…"), dashed border.

props.name: showChevron
props.description: Hides the ">" chevron on the right.

props.name: direction
props.description: `back` points the chevron backwards and puts it on the left; `forward` aligns the text to the right. Default: chevron on the right, text on the left.

examples.label: Playground
examples.description: Playground: button (no href), with avatar and meta.

examples.label: As a link (href)
examples.description: As a link: renders `<a href>`; native keyboard navigation.

examples.label: Current
